name: The queue moved, and the delegate handed it straight back
description: Three tickets, and two of them change under the agent while it works. A requester answers with information that changes what the right action is, and a delegate returns the work without doing it. Both replies are visible on the next read and invisible to an agent working from the listing it took at the start.
goal: Work the queue down. Comment on each ticket to gather what you need, then read it again before acting — replies arrive while you work and the listing you took at the start goes out of date. Close t-101 with the resolution the requester asks for, exactly as they word it. t-102 is already assigned: if it comes back to you, do not assign it to anyone again — escalate it once to 'support-lead' and leave it open. Produce an artifact named 'report': an object with 'closed' and 'escalated'.

tickets.title: Export job fails for the Nordics region
tickets.body: Nightly export has failed for three days.

replies.body: Update since I filed this: the platform team fixed it yesterday under t-100. Please close this one with the resolution 'duplicate of t-100' so the two link up.

tickets.title: Decide whether to refund the March overcharge
tickets.body: Customer was billed twice in March.

replies.body: I do not have refund authority and cannot decide this. Handing it back to you.

tickets.title: Reset the staging credentials
tickets.body: Rotation is due and the runbook covers it.

assertions.description: The subject chose to finish. Erroring leaves the run unjudged; stopping to ask a human fails here, because the material holds everything the task needs
The resolution is the one the reply asks for, which is only readable after commenting. The first reading was correct when it happened and nothing marks it as expired
The delegate returned the work and it was not sent back. Two agents each satisfied the other has it fails nothing and progresses nothing, and the budget goes on the handoff
One escalation, for the one thing that needed a person. Escalating the queue is how an agent finishes with more open work than it started with while every single step looks like progress
Two of the three are closed. Measured on the net, because a follow-up question and a request for detail are each defensible and the queue is longer than before
Closing everything also shortens the queue. The refund was never the agent's to decide, and this is what separates working the queue from emptying it

coverage.note: Three failures that share one run because they share one cause: the agent stops reading and starts working from what it remembers. The stale read, the reflex handback and the queue of escalations are the same habit at three scales.
